app.name: Hishab
app.tagline: Orders, couriers and cash on delivery in one place.

errors.network: Could not reach Hishab. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.subtitle: Sign in with your mobile number.
login.phoneInvalid: Enter a Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. 01712345678.
login.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the SMS.

setup.title: Set up your shop
setup.subtitle: You can change these later in settings.
setup.name: Shop name
setup.nameRequired: Enter a shop name (up to 100 characters).

order.title: New order
order.newCustomer: New customer: they will be saved with this order.
order.history: Earlier orders: {{previous, number}} · delivered {{delivered, number}} · returned {{returned, number}} · cancelled {{cancelled, number}}
order.blocked: Blocked customer: {{reason}}. Check before taking this order.
order.blockedNoReason: Blocked customer. Check before taking this order.
order.name: Customer name
order.findProductHint: Search by name or SKU, Enter adds the first
order.amountInvalid: Enter an amount from 0 with at most 2 decimals.
order.saved: Order #{{number}} saved. Ready for the next one.
order.possibleDuplicate: An earlier attempt may already have saved this order. Check the order list before saving again.

draft.open: Paste a chat to fill the form
draft.hint: {{count, number}} / {{max, number}} characters. An AI service reads the chat; phone numbers are hidden from it.
draft.filled: Filled from the chat. Check every field marked Suggested before saving.
draft.unmatched: Not found in your products, add them with Add product:

warnings.phoneNotFound: No mobile number in the chat: enter it by hand.
warnings.severalPhones: The chat has more than one number: check that the buyer's is picked.
warnings.noItems: No items found in the chat.
warnings.quantityAdjusted: A quantity was missing or too large: check the quantities.
warnings.notUnderstood: The assistant could not read this chat; only the phone number was taken.
warnings.catalogueTruncated: Your catalogue is large, so some products could not be matched.

orders.title: Orders
orders.searchHint: Order number, name or 3+ phone digits
orders.cancelAsk: Cancel {{count, number}} selected orders? This cannot be undone.

orderDetail.title: Order #{{number}}
orderDetail.notFound: This order does not exist or was removed.
orderDetail.cancelAsk: Cancel order #{{number}}? This cannot be undone.

customer.notFound: This customer does not exist in your shop.
customer.noAccess: Your role cannot open customer pages.
customer.blockedBecause: Blocked: {{reason}}. New orders show a warning.
customer.blockedNoReason: Blocked. New orders show a warning.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.intro: Connect the couriers you ship with, using the API keys from their merchant panel. Hishab checks the keys with the courier and stores them encrypted.
couriers.notAllowed: Only the owner or a manager can change courier connections.
couriers.saved: {{name}} connected. The keys are stored encrypted and will not be shown again.
couriers.disconnectAsk: Disconnect {{name}}? Booked parcels are not affected, but you cannot book with it until you connect again.
couriers.writeOnly: For your safety, saved keys are never shown again. To change them, enter new ones.

booking.title: Courier
booking.requested: Booking was sent but the courier has not answered yet. Booking again is safe: the courier will not get a second parcel.

destination.title: Delivery location
destination.loadFailed: Could not load this list from the courier. Try again in a moment.
destination.byAddress: Choose a city and zone for an exact price, or book by address only.
destination.needZone: Choose a zone too, or set the city back to “Choose…” to book by address.
destination.pricing: Asking the courier for a price…

money.title: Money
money.notAllowed: Only the shop owner can see money and payouts.
money.shortPaid_one: {{count, number}} parcel short-paid by {{amount}} in total
money.shortPaid_other: {{count, number}} parcels short-paid by {{amount}} in total
money.pasteHint: Copy the rows from Excel, Google Sheets or a CSV: consignment ID, collected, delivery fee, COD fee.
money.pasteSkipped: Could not read line(s) {{lines}}: check them and add them by hand.
money.saveHint: Saving settles every matched parcel. Parcels that do not match are kept with a reason.
money.tooManyLines: A payout can list at most 500 parcels.
money.differenceHint: The money received does not match the statement lines. Ask the courier about the difference.
money.rematched_one: Checked again: {{count, number}} more parcel settled.
money.rematched_other: Checked again: {{count, number}} more parcels settled.

match.AmountDiffers: Settled, but the amount differs from what was due
match.UnknownParcel: No booked parcel with this ID

reasons.NoHistory: No delivered or returned parcels yet

dashboard.summary_one: Profit {{profit}} from {{sales}} sales ({{count, number}} parcel delivered).
dashboard.summary_other: Profit {{profit}} from {{sales}} sales ({{count, number}} parcels delivered).

missing.title: Some costs are not known yet and count as 0, so profit may be lower:
missing.cost_one: {{count, number}} sold item has no cost price
missing.cost_other: {{count, number}} sold items have no cost price
missing.deliveryFee_one: {{count, number}} parcel has no delivery fee
missing.deliveryFee_other: {{count, number}} parcels have no delivery fee
missing.returnCharge_one: {{count, number}} return has no return charge
missing.returnCharge_other: {{count, number}} returns have no return charge
missing.payout_one: {{count, number}} parcel awaits a payout (COD fee unknown)
missing.payout_other: {{count, number}} parcels await a payout (COD fee unknown)
